explanation: Kant was born in the Prussian port in 1724 and taught at its university for decades. After the Second World War it became Kaliningrad, in the Soviet Union.

claims.text: Immanuel Kant spent nearly all his life in Königsberg.
Nietzsche, Schopenhauer and Hegel did not spend their lives in Königsberg.
According to a popular story, Kant's daily walks were so regular that his neighbours set their clocks by them.
Kant was born in Königsberg in 1724.
Kant taught at the University of Königsberg for decades.
After the Second World War Königsberg became part of the Soviet Union and was renamed Kaliningrad in 1946.
